verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a real-time authorization webhook, spending controls by merchant category, and ML risk scores on authorizations. None of it documents that authorization events carry merchant name or MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet or entry-mode details, or partial-approval and incremental-auth signals. Category-based spending controls and risk scores are adjacent features, not the authorization payload context this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, every authorization event carries decision-grade context — merchant name and MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals
